verdict.label: Light review
verdict.summary: Unlisted distribution is self-serve in minutes, but unlisted apps created after May 29, 2025 get conversations.history throttled to 1 request/minute; lifting that needs Slack Marketplace approval (10+ active workspaces, up to 10 weeks of review).

composioFit.summary: Composio provides a managed Slack app out of the box. Use a custom app when custom scopes, custom consent branding, or dedicated rate limit quotas are needed.
whyOwnApp: Custom branding: Display your own app name and logo on Slack OAuth authorization screens.
Custom scopes: Request specific bot or user scopes not included in Composio managed defaults.
Dedicated API quotas: Avoid shared rate limits across managed app users, especially for conversations.history.

phases.name: Create Slack App
steps: Go to Slack API App Management dashboard and create a new Slack app.
Select your development workspace for initial app creation.
Configure basic scopes under OAuth & Permissions.
phases.handoff: App client ID and client secret created.

phases.name: Configure Composio Custom Auth
steps: Create a custom auth config for SLACK in the Composio dashboard.
Copy the HTTPS redirect URI provided by Composio.
Add the redirect URI under Slack OAuth & Permissions -> Redirect URLs.
Copy Slack Client ID and Client Secret back into Composio.
phases.handoff: OAuth credentials linked between Slack and Composio.

phases.name: Activate Public Distribution
steps: Navigate to Manage Distribution in Slack App Settings.
Click Activate Public Distribution to enable installation across non-development workspaces.
phases.handoff: App is ready for unlisted distribution across multiple workspaces.

phases.name: Test & Pilot (10 Workspaces)
steps: Connect test accounts via Composio OAuth flow to verify permissions.
Distribute app to pilot users across at least 10 active workspaces to meet Marketplace prerequisites.
phases.handoff: 10 active workspaces accumulated for optional Marketplace submission.

phases.name: Slack Marketplace Review
steps: Record demo video showing OAuth flow, setup, usage, and uninstallation without terminal/code view.
Submit app listing information and scope justifications.
Await preliminary review (up to 10 business days) and functional review (up to 10 weeks).
phases.handoff: Slack Marketplace listing approved and published.

artefacts.body:
chat:write - Required to post AI agent responses, workflow alerts, and user notifications to channels.
commands - Required to allow workspace users to trigger agent actions via slash commands.

artefacts.title: Marketplace Review Demo Video Script
artefacts.body:
1. Show initial authorization trigger link redirecting to Slack OAuth consent screen.
2. Complete installation into a secondary non-development Slack workspace.
3. Show user executing a bot slash command and receiving an automated agent response.
4. Show full uninstallation process under Workspace Settings -> Manage Apps.
Note: Exclude code editors, terminal windows, or unreleased features.

requirements.label: HTTPS Redirect URI
requirements.when: Always required for Slack OAuth 2.0 authorization flows.

requirements.label: 10 Active Workspace Installs
requirements.when: Required prior to submitting an app for Slack Marketplace listing.

requirements.label: Full-Flow Review Demo Video
requirements.when: Required when submitting new apps or updates adding functionality/scopes to Slack Marketplace.

requirements.label: Marketplace approval to avoid the 1 request/minute history limit
requirements.when: Only if your agent reads channel history at volume and the app is distributed outside your own workspace

scopes.purpose: Read public channel messages (via conversations.history / conversations.replies)
scopes.alternative: Request Marketplace approval if your agent reads history at volume: unlisted apps are limited to 1 request/minute on these methods
Use granular bot scopes; Marketplace review rejects legacy/restricted scopes

redirectRules.rule: Must use HTTPS protocol and cannot contain an anchor (#).
The requested redirect_uri must match or be a subdirectory of a Redirect URL configured under App Management.
When multiple Redirect URLs are configured, the exact same redirect_uri value must be sent in both authorize and token access steps.

blockers.cause: The redirect_uri parameter sent during authorization does not match the configured Redirect URL or differs between authorize and access steps.
blockers.fix: Ensure exact string match for redirect_uri in both authorize and access requests, matching the URL configured in Slack OAuth & Permissions.
blockers.fallback: Use Composio's managed OAuth app to bypass manual redirect URI setup.

blockers.symptom: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests when calling conversations.history or conversations.replies
blockers.cause: Unlisted non-Marketplace commercial apps created after May 29, 2025 are throttled to 1 request per minute and 15 items per request.
blockers.fix: Submit the app for review and listing in Slack Marketplace to restore standard Tier 3 rate limits (50+ req/min).
blockers.fallback: Use webhook events or Real-time Search API instead of polling conversation history.

blockers.symptom: App automatically uninstalled from customer workspace without warning
blockers.cause: The user who originally authorized an app using extended scopes left the workspace or became a guest user.
blockers.fix: Have a active workspace admin re-authenticate the app installation.
blockers.fallback: Limit app scopes strictly to basic bot/commands/identify permissions.

checklist.text: Create a new app in Slack App Management dashboard.
Configure initial bot permission scopes under OAuth & Permissions.
Create a custom Auth Config for SLACK in Composio Dashboard.
Add Composio callback URL to Redirect URLs in Slack App Management.
Copy Client ID and Client Secret into Composio Auth Config.
Activate Public Distribution in Slack App Management for multi-workspace access.
Test OAuth installation flow using Composio connect link.
Install app across 10 active workspaces to satisfy Marketplace review prerequisites.
Record review demo video demonstrating install, usage, and uninstall without showing code/terminal.
Submit app for Slack Marketplace review and track status in App Management.
